scripts.setup: bun install && bun run setup:client && bun run setup:server
scripts.setup:server: cd server && dotnet restore && dotnet tool restore && cp appsettings.example.json appsettings.json && dotnet tool run dotnet-ef database update
scripts.build: cd client && bun run build && cd ../server && dotnet build
scripts.check: cd client && bun run check && cd ../server && dotnet test Tests/ResolveDesk.Tests.csproj
scripts.db:update: cd server && dotnet ef database update
